Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileReader;
import java.io.IOException;

public class FileDemo {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            FileReader fileReader = new FileReader(new File("log.txt"));
            int n;
            StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();

            while ((n = fileReader.read()) != -1) {
                stringBuilder.append((char) n);
            }

            System.out.println(stringBuilder.toString());
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}
